# Campus Radar

> Independent student-built University of Michigan opportunity discovery.

Research, scholarships and internships matched to student goals. Beta coverage is limited and qualifications require checking with the original publisher.

## Public information
- [Product and access guide](https://campus-radar-umich.aswelltoo.chatgpt.site/docs): Coverage, privacy, sign-in and agent access boundaries.
- [Privacy](https://campus-radar-umich.aswelltoo.chatgpt.site/privacy): Personal information and controls.
- [Student setup](https://campus-radar-umich.aswelltoo.chatgpt.site/beta): Requires the student's own sign-in.

Personal profiles, reports, forwarded email and administrator tools are private. No anonymous personal-data API is offered.
